limitations: The numerical profile remains PRIVATE and unadmitted by the production preparer; strict default is unchanged.
Target covers frozen integer windows at 512 blocks only. Native 4096-block, transition, retrigger, cold and fractional checks do not qualify those modes on target.
No universal mathematical accuracy proof for arbitrary input, length, mode or graph.
The cost run compares already compacted strict accumulation with Neumaier on four dyadic cases. It does not measure corrected strict cancellation processing.
The identical-artifact control proves the declared target oracle cases, not improvement versus strict output.
Offline core1 FX callbacks. Input/oracle generation, events, create/prepare, cache copy, I2S, UI and networking are outside process timing; no complete instrument deadline bound.
Native and target sine-library input bytes are not assumed identical; actual target input/oracle cache fingerprints are bound and checked.
Zero observed running heap/module-local late counters are not a blanket libc allocator coverage claim.
Finite test inputs do not cover the complete NaN/subnormal/exception domain. The separate float32-corners observation has its own bounded scope.

numerical_policy.algorithm: Neumaier compensation with a Float32 accumulator and residual for both insertion and removal; output is the corrected sum divided by available count.
numerical_policy.history_policy: Write order, indices, available count, divisor and caller/clock/resource routes remain unchanged under the inverse whole-header proof.
numerical_policy.native_oracle: Fresh math.fsum over each literal Float32 window, fixed causal lag zero; no fitted lag or running oracle.
numerical_policy.reset: Residual is initialized/reset with the accumulator. Changed truncated window resets before the current input; unchanged-window retrigger preserves state.
numerical_policy.target_oracle: Fresh Float64 window sum over the actual cached Float32 input, rounded once into the Float32 cache. Maximum output/cache error plus maximum cache/model rounding error must remain <=2e-6.
